units.source_text: 过了四五天后，有一回，发长彦带着三只狗，吹着笛子，走到了葛城山山脚下的一个三岔路口。

en.t: Four or five days later, one day, Kaminagahiko took his three dogs with him and, playing his flute, walked to a fork in the road at the foot of Mount Katsuragi.

units.source_text: 左右两边的路上，各有一位身佩弓箭的年轻武士骑着俊马过来。

en.t: From the roads on the left and right, a young warrior wearing a bow and arrows came riding toward him on a fine horse from each side.
